reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text: Do instant lifting look but not for daily use
reviews.zh: 做到即時提拉嘅效果，但唔適合日日用。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text: So amazing product, very fast delivery, highly recommended
reviews.zh: 產品超正，速遞超快，強烈推薦。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text: They work great and stay on for a long time (even overnight). Wish they were bigger.
reviews.zh: 效果好好，而且好持久（過夜都得）。希望可以再大塊啲。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text: Not so easy to apply. You can use the sheets for neck or forehead but it’s just 5 pieces, not 5 for forehead and 5 for neck
reviews.zh: 唔係好容易用。可以用嚟敷頸或者額頭，但只有 5 片，唔係額頭 5 片加頸 5 片。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text: I tried this once and I absolutely loved the results, of course u need to use more than one time. Probably after u finish the box with the 5 packages u can notice better results. I used it on my neck and it felt and looked better. Use it with dry hands
reviews.zh: 我試咗一次，效果好好，當然要用多過一次先得。可能用完成盒 5 包之後會見到更明顯嘅效果。我用喺頸上，感覺同望落都好咗。要用乾手操作。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text:
なんだかよくわからかったけど、コラーゲン？を補えるのかな？？
効果もいまいちわからないけど、使ってます笑
reviews.zh:
雖然唔太清楚係咩，但可以補充膠原蛋白嗎？？
效果都唔太清楚，但都用緊笑

reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text:
本来はエッセンスミストが必要ですがクリニークのモイスチャーサージスプレーを使用しています。
シワを無くす程の効果や即効性は無さそうですが、首がふっくらした感じがしました。
何回か試して少しづつ効果が現れることを期待。
reviews.zh:
本來需要配合精華噴霧，但我用咗 Clinique 嘅 Moisture Surge 噴霧。
睇唔出有去皺或者即時嘅效果，但覺得條頸望落飽滿咗。
希望試多幾次之後效果會慢慢見到。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Melting Collagen Neck & Forehead Film 5P+
reviews.text: Love the melting collagen but I have to buy the mist separately. I will stick with BOH
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款融化膠原蛋白，但噴霧要另外買。我會繼續用 BOH。
